title: mail-parser: Uncaught exceptions and silent header loss in mail-parser on attacker-controlled input (CVE-2026-129299)
description: mail-parser versions prior to 4.6.2 contain multiple issues where attacker-controlled email headers can cause uncaught exceptions, silent loss or substitution of header values, and incorrect parsing results without error flags. These flaws arise from improper attribute lookup and normalization of header names, leading to evasion and denial of service. The issues are fixed in version 4.6.2.
